rules.rule: PF and PJ flows are mutually exclusive.
PF accepts one or more individual contractors; every listed PF must sign.
PJ accepts exactly one legal entity with one or more representatives; every listed representative must sign.
More than one PJ in the same automatic contract is unsupported and must be handled manually.
Closer informs only the quantitative number of legal practice areas, not their names.
1 area => 7 business days; 2 => 10; 3 => 15.
4 or more areas => MANUAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED.
Implementation clock starts at the Onboarding meeting.
Number of media channels and Landing Pages does not independently extend implementation target.
Client dependencies suspend/recalculate affected deadlines.
Allowed standard channels: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, GPT Ads, Other.
Selecting Other requires a specified platform name.
Media cap is one monthly global cap shared by all selected channels.
Spend above the cap requires negotiation and may lead to commercial review.
Landing Page is optional and independent of media channel.
If included, Closer informs only the total initial quantity.
Landing Pages are initial implementation deliverables; renewal does not replenish the initial quantity.
Closer informs only total creative slots per contractual period; no format split.
Each static piece consumes 1 slot; each video consumes 1 slot.
Video script and editing are included in the same video slot.
Automatic renewal provides the same quantity of creative slots for the new period unless expressly changed.
Rota Academy is included by default; Closer can mark No.
When Academy is included, Remote Commercial Consulting is also included, without contractual numeric/frequency limit.
Flowjuris is included by default; Closer can mark No.
When included, Flowjuris is embedded in Assessoria monthly fee with no individual price.
Included scope: access, implementation/use trail, initial setup support, ongoing support limited to usage questions.
End of Assessoria ends bundled Flowjuris unless client separately contracts it at then-current market conditions.
If not separately contracted, access remains for 7 days for client-led data export/removal.
After 7 days, no contractual obligation to keep active environment, export later, recover, restore or reactivate, subject to legal retention.
Metrics update is weekly; checkpoint meeting is monthly.
Automatic-contract terms are restricted to 3, 6, or 12 months.
Fidelity is a free integer in months, minimum 3 and maximum equal to selected term.
Automatic renewal repeats original term length.
Fidelity applies only to initial contract and never renews.
After fidelity, termination requires 30-day prior notice.
Immediate termination after fidelity without serving notice generates one current monthly fee plus applicable accrued/proportional obligations.
Commercial adjustment can apply only to next renewed period, with at least 30 days prior notice.
No price adjustment applies during an already-started contractual period.
Monthly payment: boleto/PIX or recurring credit card.
First invoice date may differ from recurring due day.
Invoice/payment dates only settle financial obligations and never define contractual cycles.
Contractual cycle is based solely on service_start_date.
Operational setup fixed nominal value is BRL 1,000.00.
Closer marks setup Charged or Exempt.
If charged: boleto/PIX with monthly invoice or card up to 12 installments, operator fees borne by client.
If charged, Closer informs payment date.
Late-payment fine is 10% of overdue installment.
Default interest is 1% per month pro rata die.
IPCA monetary correction applies when delay exceeds 30 days.
Services may be suspended after 10 days of delinquency.
At 20 days, extrajudicial collection/formal measures may begin.
Before termination solely for default, grant additional 5 business days after formal notice.
Termination during fidelity: fine = 20% of remaining financial obligations for fidelity period.
Payment history does not determine consumed service cycle; remaining fidelity is based on service time.
Signature date is entered by Closer and independent from document generation date.
Service start date is entered by Closer and independent from signature date.
No guaranteed financial/commercial/contracting results.
No continuous organic social-media management unless expressly contracted.
No direct lead service, qualification, negotiation or closing under standard Assessoria.
Third-party platform events excluded to extent not directly attributable to Rota; reasonable mitigation within Rota's sphere remains required.
